prompt: Design an expressive macOS Travel Time widget using all attached images as visual references. Generate one coherent composition with Small (160x160), Medium (340x160), and Large (340x340) layouts for light and dark themes. Use the provided ideas as composition options: split-flap map, route nodes, mode stepper, dark street scrim, or cobalt stack. Select one family and adapt it consistently to all sizes. Small: live travel duration, event name, and one simple detail. Medium: small content plus the real destination and event start time. Large: medium content plus only additional route information supplied at runtime. Current provider supplies one Google Maps driving duration for the next located calendar event, home and destination; it does not supply map tiles, traffic, leave-by time, or other travel modes. Never invent route details or estimates. Keep text at least 11px except the hero, use 24px outer corners, 16px small/20px other padding, 8px spacing grid and 12px group gaps, accessible contrast, and no clipping. No gallery or selector.
designSpec: The cobalt-stack family uses oversized duration typography, 24px outer corners, and theme-aware white or charcoal supporting surfaces. Runtime layout selects Small (160×160), Medium (340×160), or Large (340×340), displaying only that variant with no selector. Missing inputs remain explicitly unavailable; Large adds the home origin only when supplied, without invented maps, traffic, or route estimates.
stages: Fitting the data into the widget
